shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -50 && printf '\\n--- theme refs ---\\n' && rg -n \"ThemeProvider|theme|dark|light\" -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md; printf '\\n--- traps ---\\n'; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx; printf '\\n--- app refs ---\\n'; rg -n \"App|Switch|Theme\" src -g '"'!node_modules'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- docs ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Switch.md 2>/dev/null || true; printf '\\n--- theme dts ---\\n'; rg -n \"useTheme|ThemeContextProps|type Theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; printf '\\n--- package version ---\\n'; node -e \"console.log(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version)\""

/bin/bash -lc "rg -l \"declare function Switch|declare const Switch|useTheme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; printf '\\n--- exports ---\\n'; rg -n \"(Switch|useTheme|useUpdateTheme)\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/index.d.ts | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"ThemeProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -40; printf '\\n--- theme components ---\\n'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme; rg -n \"theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' src/main.tsx; printf '\\n--- App ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; git diff -- src/main.tsx src/App.tsx 2>/dev/null || true"
